issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core HTTP issue asking to document how response is populated in history entries, especially response.lastModified for deleted resources, and to include an example fragment for a deleted item.
initial_application: The Jira comment says SVN revision 13074 applied the issue. In git, 7850c9a122cd7af5c161560109c21e5c650b4df2 is '#13662 - document delete in history' and added response.lastModified guidance plus a DELETE history-entry example to source/http.html.
additional_context: Related Published/current decisions FHIR-17075, FHIR-38942, and FHIR-7933 are already represented on the combined branch. Together they confirm and reconcile the current request/response requirements for history Bundles, including Bundle invariants and the active HTTP history paragraph. Direct Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-13662 found no conflicting community record; a broader Zulip result used the same deleted-resource response.lastModified pattern.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source/http.html history section now says history entries SHALL contain request and response, explains that DELETE history entries omit resource, shows a DELETE example with response.status and response.lastModified, and recommends response.lastModified to make processing time clear. Bundle source also requires response on history entries and response.status when response is present.
